data.description: uNaice ist Pionier im Bereich der automatisierten Contentproduktion und automatisierten Datenaufbereitung und -anreicherung. Wir entwickeln Kunden, die sich auf der Welle der Digitalisierung befinden. Unsere Kunden sind u.A. Top-Player im E-Commerce wie adidas, Wago, TUI, C&A, aber auch Verlage wie Neue Westfälische Zeitung, Volksstimme und vor allem internationale Hersteller, mit sehr großen Datenmengen und Bedarf an internationalem Content. Unsere Arbeit versetzt die Pioniere der Branche in die Lage, automatisiert Daten und/ooder Content zu normieren, zu glätten, zu strukurieren und anzureichern und dies alles vollautomatisch. Kurz gesagt: Wir können aus Texten Datensätze mit Attributen und Attributswerten machen, oder aus Daten auf Knopfdruck unique, conversionstarke und SEO-relevante Produktbeschreibungen und Kategorieseiten erstellen und publizieren. Und das in 110 Sprachen. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Entwickler/Developer für 20h in Festanstellung. Dein gemeldeter Wohnsitz ist in Deutschland. Du arbeitest auch in Deutschland. Dein Anschreiben wünschen wir uns in deutscher Sprache. Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend. Aufgaben Deine Aufgaben Als Junior Backend Developer, mit gleichzeitigen Kenntnissen in React, wirkst du aktiv mit bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres Backends rund um DataContentNaicer. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören: Entwicklung und Wartung von Backend‑Services mit Python (z. B. REST / GraphQL APIs) Integration und Verarbeitung von Datenquellen (verschiedene Formate wie JSON, CSV, XML etc.) Aufbau und Optimierung von Datenpipelines & Datenmodellierung (Datenbereinigung, Attribut/Auswahl von Feature‑Parametern etc.) Zusammenarbeit mit dem Frontend-Team: Sicherstellen, dass APIs performant, stabil und gut dokumentiert sind Schreiben von Tests, Code Reviews und Mitarbeit in einem agilen Team Deployment, Monitoring und Troubleshooting von Backend-Komponenten Qualitätssicherung des Front-Ends in React Qualifikation Dein Profil Must-haves: Abgeschlossenes Informatik-Studium oder vergleichbar Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python (z. B. mit Frameworks wie Flask, FastAPI oder Django) Gute Grundkenntnisse mit React Erfahrung mit API‑Design (REST oder GraphQL) Vertrautheit mit Datenformaten wie JSON, CSV, XML Grundkenntnisse in der Arbeit mit Datenbanken (relational oder NoSQL) Gute Problemlösefähigkeit und Lust, in einem wachstumsorientierten Produktteam mitzuarbeiten Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Nice-to-haves: Erfahrung mit Datenverarbeitungslibraries wie Pandas, NumPy etc. Erfahrung mit Automatisierung, Datenpipelines, ETL‑Prozessen Kenntnisse in Cloud‑Technologien (z. B. AWS, Azure oder vergleichbares) Erfahrung mit Versionierung (Git), CI/CD, Testing‑Frameworks Interesse an Textautomatisierung, semantischen Daten / Ontologien etc. Benefits Das bieten wir dir: Einflussreiche Rolle in einem zukunftsorientierten Produktteam bei einem innovationsgetriebenen Unternehmen Arbeiten an DataContentNaicer – einer Lösung, die echtes KI-Potential zur Datenoptimierung erschließt (bis zu 80 % Zeitersparnis, Attributerweiterungen, API‑Integration) Agile Arbeitsweise, offene Kommunikation und Raum für kreative Lösungen Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und moderne Technologien Karriereperspektiven – Entwickle dich mit uns weiter und sammle wertvolle Erfahrungen für deine Zukunft. Remote arbeiten zu 100% Zeitsouveränes arbeiten: Du planst deine Arbeiten & Zeit grundsätzlich selbst, sie müssen jedoch in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und Kollegen harmonieren (Zeitfenster, aus Erfahrung Mo-Fr 7-18 Uhr) Rahmenbedingungen & Vergütung Arbeitszeit: je nach Vereinbarung, idealerweise zwischen 20h, perspektifisch anwachsend. Vergütung: abhängig von Erfahrung und Qualifikation, es wird gemeinsam eine faire Lösung gefunden Vertrag: unbefristet, bezahlte Probearbeit mit Aufgabenpaketen möglich So bewirbst du dich: Deinen Lebenslauf Ein kurzes Anschreiben, in dem du erklärst, warum du Backend‑Entwicklung und speziell Python spannend findest und was du bisher gemacht hast Beispiele / Referenzen oder Codeprojekte, wenn vorhanden Wir arbeiten ausschließlich remote. Unsere Mitarbeiter sind verteilt an unterschiedlichen Orten in Deutschland. Remote bedeutet nicht unprofessionell. Wir setzen einen geeigneten Arbeitsraum voraus. Arbeiten “von der Bettkante” ist nicht unser Ding. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Los gehts. Sende uns neben deinem aussagekräftigen Lebenslauf UND auch ein Anschreiben, das überzeugt. Wir freuen uns, dich dann zügig zu einem Web-Interview einzuladen.

data.description: Principal AI Engineer (AI / .NET Core / React) At Mitratech, we’re a team of engineers passionate about building world-class products that empower Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR professionals at Fortune 100 companies. We thrive in a global, inclusive culture that values innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. With continued growth, we’re looking for a Principal AI Engineer to join our HotDocs Team . HotDocs is Mitratech’s flagship document automation platform, used by enterprise clients worldwide to streamline the assembly of complex legal documents and contracts. You'll set the technical direction for AI at HotDocs - designing and delivering new AI-powered enterprise capabilities and driving our adoption of AI across the software development lifecycle. This is a remote-first role. About the Role As a Principal AI Engineer, you will: Set the AI Technical Direction: Own the architecture for AI capabilities across HotDocs - model management, LLM and agent orchestration, retrieval strategy, evaluation, cost and latency management - and translate it into a pragmatic delivery roadmap. Deliver Enterprise AI Features: Take new AI-powered features from prototype to production at enterprise scale, writing clean, maintainable code in .NET Core and React and holding the bar for performance, security, and readability. Drive AI Adoption in the SDLC: Lead how we use AI across engineering - coding assistants, agentic workflows, test generation, code review, and documentation - selecting tooling, defining safe and effective usage patterns, and measuring the impact on delivery. Build Trustworthy AI: Establish evaluation harnesses, guardrails, observability, and AI governance practices so that AI features are accurate, explainable, and safe for use in regulated, compliance-heavy environments. Bring Deep Technical Expertise: Apply strong .NET and React ecosystem knowledge to complex problems, modernize and refactor legacy code where it blocks AI integration, and improve system scalability and reliability. Lead and Mentor: Raise the AI capability of the wider engineering group through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, brown-bag sessions, and clear written guidance. Influence Across the Business: Partner with product management, architecture, security, and customer-facing teams to shape the AI roadmap, evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, and set realistic expectations for what AI can deliver. Enhance DevOps and AI Ops: Extend CI/CD pipelines to cover AI workloads - prompt and model versioning, automated evaluation gates, monitoring, and cost tracking - working closely with DevOps engineers. Focus on the User: Ensure AI features solve real customer problems and deliver a great experience through attention to detail, responsiveness, transparency, and accessibility. About You You are: A Technical Leader: You set direction without needing authority, build consensus across teams, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical peers. An AI Practitioner, not a Spectator: You have shipped AI features to real users, keep pace with a fast-moving field, and can tell genuine capability from hype. Evidence-Led: You care about maintainable code, testing, and measurable outcomes - you evaluate AI systems with data rather than intuition. Adaptable and Pragmatic: You balance long-term architectural goals with the practical needs of a sprint-driven environment, and you know when a simple solution beats a model. Security-, Privacy- and Performance-Minded : You build with scalability and resilience in mind, using secure-by-design principles, and you treat data privacy and responsible AI as first-order concerns. Required Skills and Experience 12 or more years of professional software development experience, including time in a principal, lead, or staff-level technical role. Strong skills in .NET Core (C#) and React (TypeScript) or similar SPA frameworks - this remains a hands-on engineering role. Demonstrable experience designing and shipping production AI solutions - LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG, MCP, and agentic or tool-calling systems. Hands-on experience with cloud AI platforms and services (e.g. Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, or equivalent) and with orchestration frameworks such as Semantic Kernel. Experience building and maintaining REST APIs . Proficiency with Entity Framework and Azure SQL (or SQL Server). Experience evaluating and improving AI system quality - test sets, benchmarking, human review loops, and handling non-deterministic behavior. Understanding of web applications and AI-specific security, including secure coding, prompt injection, and safe handling of sensitive customer data. Experience using Git and collaborating through modern workflows (e.g., pull requests, branching strategies). Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or similar). Comfortable working in agile teams using tools such as Jira and Confluence. Practical experience using AI tooling within the SDLC (e.g. coding assistants, agentic developer tools) and a view on how to adopt it well across a team. A track record of technical leadership - mentoring senior engineers, leading design reviews, and influencing roadmap and architecture decisions. Nice to Have Deeper AI specialism in areas such as SLMs and fine-tuning, CAG, vector databases, AI observability, multi-agent systems, or AI/ML pipelines. Experience with Microsoft Office Addins (office.js / VSTO) Familiarity of .NET Framework / WPF Experience with authentication standards such as OAuth and SSO . Exposure to distributed caching (e.g., Redis) Knowledge of Linux environments and containerization (Docker). Scripting in PowerShell . Familiarity with performance tuning and application diagnostics. Experience with infrastructure-as-code or automation tooling. Previous experience in enterprise SaaS or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., legaltech, fintech), particularly applying AI to document, contract, or natural language workloads. What We Offer A collaborative, supportive, and learning-focused work culture. The chance to shape an AI strategy end to end, from architecture through to production, at enterprise scale. Opportunities to grow your technical skills and career path. Remote-first flexibility with optional in-person collaboration sessions. Competitive benefits and a chance to impact how global organizations automate critical legal and compliance workflows. Join Us Ready to lead the application of AI to document automation at enterprise scale? Apply now to join Mitratech’s innovative, inclusive, and driven HotDocs engineering team.

With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the role: We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software. We treat quality as an engineering discipline. We build test infrastructure the way we build our product — real design decisions, real trade-offs, real ownership. What's changing is how that work gets done: we're moving from hand-written test suites toward agents that design, generate, maintain and triage tests across the lifecycle. We need someone to build both the agents and the infrastructure that makes them dependable, and to help shape our Quality AI strategy. You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality themselves — and to stay close enough to real features to know where that tooling breaks. Camunda also ships AI capabilities in its own product, so the evaluation practice you build for agent-driven testing feeds directly into how we test non-deterministic features. You'll join colleagues who live our FAITH values: Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent and Humor. Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale What You’ll Be Doing: Build and operate agents across the testing lifecycle — test design, generation, maintenance, execution and failure triage. Own the infrastructure that makes agent-driven testing reliable: environments, test data, tool interfaces, guardrails, runtime and cost control. Define how we measure agent output quality, so teams can trust results instead of hand-reviewing them. Apply that evaluation practice to testing Camunda 8's own AI capabilities. Work hands-on with new features as teams build them, enough to keep the tooling honest. Raise the quality capability of teams — patterns, tooling, enablement. Success is what builders can do themselves, not the number of tests you wrote. What You Bring: Ability and/or willingness to use our product 5+ years as a software engineer. You write production code daily and would be credible on a product team; quality is your domain, not a step down from development. Production experience building test infrastructure, developer tooling or internal platforms that other engineers depend on — designed and owned, not just extended. Hands-on work with LLMs or agent frameworks: prompt and context design, tool use, handling non-determinism, and evaluating output quality. This is the differentiator for the role. Comfort with distributed systems and CI at scale. Camunda 8 is a process orchestration platform; testing it means reasoning about concurrency, state and timing. The ability to drive adoption in teams that don't report to you. You've built something another team chose to use, and you know what to do when the first version isn't picked up. data.description: Senior Network Developer About Share Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months. Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served. The Role Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices. You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team. What you'll do Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time. Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist. Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable. Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change. Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop. Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system. Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off. Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you. Our Ideal Candidate 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP. Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit. Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense. Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you. You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe. You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed. AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't. You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network. A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders. Nice to have Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale. Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them. Streaming telemetry (gNMI/gRPC, sFlow), and building your own monitoring tooling. 400G/800G and optical (ZR) deployments, including vendor selection and certification. Access networks (GPON/XGS-PON) and MikroTik or Huawei gear, since many partner ISPs run it. Building networks in emerging markets such as Africa or Latin America. DDoS mitigation at the edge. If you don't tick every box but have built and run large networks in production, apply anyway. Compensation & Benefits Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a venture-backed company (US-incorporated, with a Kenya operating entity)
